notes:
Trusted the real stylesheet + frames over the raw profile on three points. (1) The profile reports keyframeCount:0 and respectsReducedMotion:false — both artifacts of 5 blocked cross-origin sheets; the fetched CSS contains exactly one @keyframes (`blobble`) and THREE prefers-reduced-motion blocks (navbar transition, card skew/flip via `no-preference`, catalog marquee) plus a `body.reduce-motion` class for the site's own toggle. reduced_motion is therefore 'respected' but PARTIAL: the infinite blobble loop is not gated. (2) The profile's 16 `scroll_effects` on `.cloudbit` (scale 1.03→1.05 etc.) are the blobble loop sampled at different phases across scroll stops, NOT scroll-progress transforms — there is no scroll-linked JS for them. (3) `transparent_height_pct: 48` is a false positive: sections are transparent because their parent `div.colorsection` paints the band. No fixed backdrop, no blend modes, no backdrop-filter anywhere (has_static_backdrop:false, has_blend_overlay:false, blend_glass empty).
Colors normalized from the site's sRGB fallbacks; every pigment also ships a `@supports (color: color(display-p3 …))` wide-gamut variant (display-p3 is why the raw profile reports all colors in that space). `bg` is set to the brand yellow because it is the page's signature ground, but the page has NO single bg — it is eight full-bleed bands, listed under roles.band-*. `color.dark` is real: an authored `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` block re-points the SAME semantic roles (page-bg→black, text→white, accent→purple, link/bright→brand-yellow) — note the accent/link SWAP relative to light. The desktop-dark screenshot is not the frontpage's own dark render (the frontpage's bands are opaque and unaffected); the dark palette applies to the site's app/store chrome.
Type scale in rem assumes the capped desktop root of 10px (html: 2.4px → 0.909vw from 240px → 10px fixed above 1100px). Body is an unusually large 2.85rem/28.5px; the h2 is only 2.4× body — hierarchy is carried by weight (400→800) and the color band, not by scale. The one letterSpacing value (-0.165px ≈ -0.006em) is on the wordmark only. Radius kept in `em` because the whole page is em/rem-relative; `0px` is the game-card grid, `50%` the cloud blobs. Shadow scale is effectively `none` — the third entry is the single elaborated CTA and is a signature, not a scale step.
